en: "From: Romulus Army,{n} Special Service Agency HQ{n} To: Special Service 2nd Lt. {hero:6}"
"Stand by in Ship Town, in the{n} demilitarized zone, and await contact{n} from Special Service Captain Ixion."

"With one of those hanging around,{n} us Rheinmetall boys will lose{n} our luck on the battlefield!"
"Please, gentlemen, not in here.{n} This town is neutral ground.{n} Take any trouble outside."
"Hey, Romulus boy. You do know{n} which country's army we are,{n} don't you?"
"The proud army of the Kingdom of{n} Rheinmetall, the only one to fight to{n} the end of the Ordoba War 100 years ago."
"The treasure sleeping on this{n} island of steel will be ours{n} before long, too."
"Quit wasting your effort and{n} clear out, if you know what's{n} good for you."
"Still, a brat like this is a soldier?{n} Romulus must be awfully{n} short on men, huh?"
"Heh heh heh heh! A brat wants{n} milk, not booze, right? The kind{n} that tastes like Mama's tit."
"Sounds good! I'd like a suck myself!"
"Ah...{w:1} aah...{w:1} what just happened?{n} My{w:1}.{w:1}.{w:1}. arm.{w:1}.{w:1}. it's gone!?{n} A black sword{w:1}... his sword{w:1}... aah?"
"Unbelievable! A real knight,{n} still alive in this day and age!"
"A soldier of proud Rheinmetall{n} won't die from losing an arm or two."
"Watch yourself, kid. Pride is the{n} one thing that lot have plenty of.{n} They'll get back at you somewhere."
"...This is a battlefield. I'm{n} surrounded by enemies either way."
"Still, that's some sword arm.{n} And he looks only 15 or 16."
"In another age he'd be knighted{n} and walking the road of glory in{n} the palace's royal guard, but..."
"Sad to say, he was born too late."
"What decides a war now is flying{n} machines, big guns, tanks, heavy MGs,{n} and the heartless soldiers: Voids."
"Hey, you Romulus brat!{n} You made fools of us back there!"
"My buddy lost his arm.{n} I'm here to pay you back for it!"
"I don't know about 'real knight'{n} or whatever, but..."
"I'm about to teach you that sideshow{n} tricks like yours are worth nothing{n} in this day and age!"
"This town is a demilitarized{n} neutral zone. One slip and it's{n} an international incident."
"This is a private fight! A drunken{n} brawl kills a punk from a puny land!{n} Old story on this island of steel!"
"You only caught us off guard before.{n} You can't beat this many men{n} plus Voids, can you, huh!?"
"Ngh... no way...? ...Guns...{n} losing to a sword? And to...{n} a brat like this...!?"
"Even the Void... cut clean in two...{n} ...So this is... a real knight?{n} Strong... we never had a chance..."
"You said it, right? A drunken brawl.{n} Killing in one is no great crime. An{n} old story on this island, isn't it?"
"Heh heh heh! Like I said,{n} I'm asking you how much!"
"And like I keep telling you, sir,{n} that's not what I'm here fooor."
"Don't be stupid. You're no soldier by{n} the look of you. On a battlefield, a{n} woman who's no soldier is THAT kind!"
"She's not young, but she's quite{n} a piece. I'll pay decent money, eh?"
"Ummm, I'm terribly sorry, but I've{n} got things to do on this island,{n} sooo..."
"Tch! What a pain!{n} Just drag her off to camp!"
"Heh heh! Now that's an idea!{n} It'll bring the unit closer together!"
"What is it, young Mr. Romulus{n} soldier? You want in on this too?"
"I'd heard...{w:1} the rumors, but...{n} ...{w:1}the Romulus army's...{w:1} Dark Knight{n} is...{w:1} a brat like this...!?"
"Thank you sooo much!{n} By the way, little boy,{n} do you live on this island!?"
"I'm a soldier, believe it or not..."
"Huh? Oh my, oh my, oh my!?{n} I do beg your pardon!"
"Don't get the wrong idea, old lady.{n} I didn't do it to save you."
"Vulgar, lowlife scum make me{n} want to puke. So I got rid of them.{n} That's all."
"Excuse me, but I am 29 years old.{n} I am most certainly nooot{n} an old lady."
"I was sure you were some thieves{n} wearing uniforms you'd stripped{n} off corpses..."
"It's awkward to say after you saved{n} me, but did you really have to{n} kill these soldiers...?"
"Even if I don't kill them, they'll{n} die soon enough. On this island of{n} steel, death is closer than life..."
"If you value your life, you should{n} get off this island fast, too."
"You know how it is, rookie? Playing{n} the petty hero on this island{n} never ends well!"
"You two are wrong on two counts."
"Two: this isn't about justice.{n} You're an eyesore, that's all."
"What's this brat on about? Oh well.{n} How about a little exercise to work{n} up an appetite before the fun?"
"Yeah, this one matters. We've got{n} to teach a rude brat how to talk{n} to his betters..."
Ten years ago the 'Blessed Isle'{n}suddenly rose from the high seas of{n}Avalon, and was called a gift from God.
But to the military men it was{n}nothing more than new territory, and{n}invasion operations began at once.
Every nation of North and South Europea{n}raced and clashed, and forced a landing{n}while warship after warship sank.
On the island lived an unidentified{n}intelligent life-form, the Defense Machines,{n}which mauled every nation's army.
As a land that must not be touched,{n}the Blessed Isle was renamed{n}the 'Steel Island of Avalon'.
Ship Town here is a neutral zone built{n}on warships sunk in the landings, the{n}scrap of land that humans did win.
A town in name only, a land of greed{n}where hungry-eyed people gather.{n}No place is farther from God's blessing.
